models.gaussian: Independent standard Gaussian local errors with one shared night shock across twelve components.
models.heavy_t3: Variance-one Student t with three degrees of freedom, plus one shared night shock.
models.linear_drift: Gaussian local errors plus a centered linear trend across each night's ordered blocks.
models.shared_local: Gaussian error has shared and local terms; timing offset is split into w/2 shared across the night and w/2 local per block.

dependence: Each trial shares a night shock across twelve components; joint verdict evaluated directly.
old_rule_adapter: Synthetic retained rows bypass ledger authentication; real evaluate_session makes numerical verdict.
